rebases.notes: First rebase (A7 drill), from chromium a21ce95c to ee456dcc. TabUndoBarController.java moved to chrome/browser/tab_ui/android (refresh exit 1; pin and 0104 renamed). Conflicts resolved with a three-way rebase of the patch commits: 0104 keeps upstream's new destroyInAppUpdate() and its TabLaunchType import, and drops the imports its undo-bar hunk leaves unused; 0110 keeps only its search guard (upstream removed the callback it used to replace); 0114 adds localeConfig beside upstream's literal zygotePreloadName; 0124 drops 159's new Ask Gemini rows with the rest and keeps upstream's KeyboardShortcuts import; 0125 keeps upstream's restart-dialog flag and profile flush. The server's gclient sync hit googlesource 429 rate limits and was retried. The lane PR (#1711) merged before compiling; making it build took #1713 (patch 0126 restores 156's android_override_version_code/_name, removed upstream; the Island's cc/mojom dependency) and #1728 (Blanc API changes: TabStateFileManager, TabModel group merge, WindowOpenDisposition, DocumentService pass key, V8 Buffer() and Data(); debug APKs marked debuggable again; gates turn on an accessibility service because 159 builds a page's tree only for a real one), merged 17:10 UTC. The release x64 build first passed at 14:12 UTC; 1.0.0-beta.6 (6), the first build on 159, was uploaded to the closed test at 00:44 UTC on Nov 24 (about 14.7 hours after starting).
